query:
INSERT INTO messages (
                        chat_id,
                        message_id,
                        user_id,
                        text,
                        created_at,
                        edited_at
                        )
                        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                        ON CONFLICT (chat_id, message_id)
                        DO UPDATE
                        SET text = EXCLUDED.text,
                        edited_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.edited_at, messages.edited_at)
